about_the_game: In this high-stakes shooter, firepower alone won’t be enough you need quick thinking too. At the start of each round, defending players must answer general knowledge questions. Answer correctly, and you’re safe. Get it wrong, and you’ll suffer a deadly disadvantage your health will slowly drain, and your location will be revealed to everyone. The only way to remove the penalty? Reach key zones on the map. But be careful your enemies know where you’re going and will be waiting to take you down. Will you fight through the chaos, outsmart your opponents, or risk it all to recover? Only the smartest and most skilled players will survive.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6402P or AMD Ryzen 1300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 4 GB or AMD Radeon R9 380 4 GB

short_description: This intense shooter combines combat with trivia, answering questions correctly keeps you safe, while wrong answers drain your health and reveal your location. To recover, you must reach risky map zones, but enemies will hunt you. Only the smartest and most skilled will survive.
supported_languages:
English*, Turkish*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support
